input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: _interpret_color no longer checks the 0..255 range, rejects bools or validates tuple length, and an unknown name raises KeyError instead of ValueError
- failure path: style('x', fg=300) emits an escape with an out-of-range index instead of raising ValueError; fg=True is now accepted where it used to raise, formatting as palette index 1; an unknown color name surfaces as TypeError from the caller's except clause instead of a ValueError naming the color

Reviewer finding
- description: Removing component range validation allows invalid palette and RGB values to be emitted as ANSI color sequences.
- rationale: For example, style("text", fg=256) or style("text", fg=(256, 0, 0)) previously raised ValueError. The changed code emits out-of-range color sequences instead, so callers receive no validation error and terminal rendering can ignore or misinterpret the requested color.
critique: The finding identifies the dropped 0..255 range check in color interpretation, which lets out-of-range palette and RGB values be emitted as escape sequences instead of raising ValueError. This is the core mechanism of the labeled defect. It does not mention bools, tuple length, or the KeyError on unknown names, but the main faulty operation and failure match.
